title: Morning Brief: A sharp warning from Goldman Sachs
title_zh: 早间简报：高盛发出尖锐警告
summary: Markets spent much of Monday in a state of confused optimism over Iran, sending markets slightly into the green, though oil prices rose.
summary_zh: 周一的大部分时间里，市场对伊朗都处于一种混乱的乐观状态，导致市场小幅上涨，尽管油价上涨。

title: Health insurers rise after US lifts 2027 Medicare Advantage payment rates
title_zh: 美国提高 2027 年 Medicare Advantage 支付费率后，健康保险公司股价上涨
summary: April 7 (Reuters) - Shares of U.S. health insurers climbed in premarket trading on Tuesday after the government said it plans a larger-than-expected increase in 2027 payment rates for Medicare
summary_zh: 路透 4 月 7 日 - 在政府表示计划 2027 年医疗保险支付率增幅超出预期后，美国健康保险公司股价周二在盘前交易中上涨

title: Apple's foldable iPhone encounters engineering snags, faces potential shipment delays, Nikkei Asia reports
title_zh: 据《日经亚洲》报道，苹果的可折叠 iPhone 遇到工程障碍，面临潜在的发货延迟
summary: April 6 (Reuters) - Apple has been encountering setbacks in the engineering test phase of its first foldable iPhone, which could lead to delays in its mass production and product shipment schedule,
summary_zh: 4 月 6 日（路透社）——苹果在其首款可折叠 iPhone 的工程测试阶段遇到了挫折，这可能导致其量产和产品发货时间表的延迟。

title: Apple's foldable iPhone faces engineering snags, potential shipment delays, Nikkei Asia reports
title_zh: 据《日经亚洲》报道，苹果的可折叠 iPhone 面临工程障碍和潜在的发货延迟
summary: Apple has been encountering setbacks in the engineering test ‌phase of its first foldable iPhone, ‌which could lead to delays in its mass ​production and product shipment schedule, Nikkei Asia reported on Monday, citing sources.
summary_zh: 据《日经亚洲》周一援引消息人士的消息称，苹果在其首款可折叠 iPhone 的工程测试阶段遇到了挫折，这可能导致其量产和产品发货计划的延迟。

title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Unite to Combat Model Copying in China
title_zh: OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google 联手打击中国的模型复制行为
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Rivals OpenAI, Anthropic PBC, and Alphabet Inc.’s Google have begun working together to try to clamp down on Chinese competitors extracting results from cutting-edge US artificial intelligence models to gain an edge in the global AI race.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——竞争对手 OpenAI、Anthropic PBC 和 Alphabet Inc. 旗下的谷歌已经开始合作，试图压制中国竞争对手从美国尖端人工智能模型中提取结果，以在全球人工智能竞赛中获得优势。

title: OpenAI vs. SpaceX IPO race: Can hype justify valuations?
title_zh: OpenAI 与 SpaceX IPO 竞赛：炒作能否证明估值合理？
summary: Futurum CEO Daniel Newman joins Yahoo Finance Markets and Data editor Jared Blikre to break down investor expectations for OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) and SpaceX's (SPAX.PVT) respective IPOs, highlighting AI competition, compute costs, and the push for real cash flow.
summary_zh: Futurum 首席执行官 Daniel Newman 与雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 一起打破了投资者对 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 和 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 各自 IPO 的预期，强调了人工智能竞争、计算成本和对实际现金流的推动。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq gain ahead of Trump deadline for Iran deal
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数在特朗普达成伊朗协议的最后期限之前上涨
summary: Reports of a ceasefire proposal are lifting hopes for an end to US-Iran hostilities.
summary_zh: 有关停火提议的报道正在提升结束美伊敌对行动的希望。

title: Mag 7 needs Q2 revenue growth in order to 'justify' massive capex
title_zh: Mag 7 需要第二季度收入增长才能“证明”大规模资本支出的合理性
summary: As the first full trading week of 2026's second quarter kicks off, what will Wall Street investors be most focused on in Big Tech and Magnificent Seven stocks?Argent Capital Management portfolio manager Jed Ellerbroek sits down with Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared ...
summary_zh: 随着 2026 年第二季度第一个完整交易周的开始，华尔街投资者最关注的是大型科技股和七大股票的哪些股票？Argent Capital Management 投资组合经理 Jed Ellerbroek 与雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared 坐下来...

title: OpenAI IPO scrutiny builds after acquiring tech podcast TBPN
title_zh: OpenAI 收购科技播客 TBPN 后 IPO 审查加强
summary: Morning Brief Anchor Julie Hyman and Yahoo Finance Head of News Myles Udland discuss rising questions around OpenAI’s (OPAI.PVT) decision to acquire technology news podcast TBPN as the AI developer eyes a potential IPO.
summary_zh: 早间简报主播朱莉·海曼 (Julie Hyman) 和雅虎财经新闻主管迈尔斯·乌德兰 (Myles Udland) 讨论了围绕 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 决定收购科技新闻播客 TBPN 的日益引发的问题，因为这家人工智能开发商正在考虑潜在的 IPO。
